image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a single sesame seed bagel resting on a dark, metallic surface (likely a pan or plate). The bagel is golden-brown with a glossy sheen, indicating a boiled-then-baked crust. It is generously topped with white sesame seeds. The central hole is visible but partially obscured by the angle and the thickness of the ring. The lighting creates strong highlights on the glaze and seeds.
